title: The Return
logline: A prodigal son returns to his village after years abroad, only to discover dark secrets that threaten his family's legacy.
synopsis: After spending fifteen years in America, Chidi returns to his ancestral village in Nigeria with dreams of modernizing his family's land. But the village elders harbor a terrible secret about his father's death, and Chidi must navigate traditional customs and modern ambitions while uncovering the truth.
cast: Chiwetel Ejiofor, Genevieve Nnaji, Pete Edochie
tags: family drama, cultural identity, secrets, homecoming

title: Lagos Nights
logline: Three friends navigate love, ambition, and betrayal in the bustling streets of Lagos.
synopsis: Amaka, Tunde, and Blessing have been inseparable since childhood. As they chase their dreams in Nigeria's most vibrant city, their friendship is tested by romantic entanglements, career ambitions, and a shocking betrayal that threatens to tear them apart forever.
cast: Ramsey Nouah, Adesua Etomi, Banky Wellington
tags: romance, friendship, urban life, coming of age

title: The Throne
logline: A young princess must prove herself worthy to rule her kingdom while battling ancient curses and political intrigue.
synopsis: Princess Adaeze never expected to inherit the throne. When her older brother mysteriously dies, she must navigate court politics, ancestral spirits, and a powerful curse that has plagued her family for generations. With the help of a wise oracle and a forbidden love, she fights to save her people and claim her destiny.
cast: Lupita Nyong'o, John Boyega, Omotola Jalade Ekeinde
tags: fantasy, royalty, magic, African mythology, political intrigue

title: The Hustler
logline: A street-smart entrepreneur must choose between easy money and honest work when a dangerous opportunity presents itself.
synopsis: Emeka has always survived by his wits on the streets of Port Harcourt. When a local crime boss offers him a fortune to help with one job, Emeka must decide if the risk is worth it. His choice will determine not just his future, but the fate of everyone he loves.
cast: O.C. Ukeje, Rita Dominic, Jim Iyke
tags: crime, thriller, moral dilemma, street life

title: Mother's Love
logline: A mother will stop at nothing to protect her children from the mistakes of her past.
synopsis: When Ngozi's estranged husband returns after ten years demanding custody of their children, she must confront the violent past she fled. With the help of her community and inner strength she didn't know she had, Ngozi fights to keep her family safe and build the future her children deserve.
cast: Funke Akindele, Richard Mofe-Damijo, Nkem Owoh
tags: family, maternal love, domestic abuse, resilience

title: Blood Money
logline: A corrupt politician's daughter must expose her father's crimes to save innocent lives.
synopsis: Zainab has lived in luxury her entire life, blind to the source of her family's wealth. When she discovers her father's political schemes have led to deaths, she faces an impossible choice: protect her family or seek justice for the victims.
cast: Nancy Isime, Kanayo O. Kanayo, Ali Nuhu
tags: political thriller, corruption, moral courage, family secrets

title: The Wedding Party Returns
logline: Another chaotic Nigerian wedding brings together feuding families, old flames, and unexpected surprises.
synopsis: When two wealthy Lagos families unite through marriage, the celebration becomes a comedy of errors. Between meddling relatives, competing vendors, and a groom with cold feet, this wedding might not make it to 'I do.'
cast: Adesua Etomi-Wellington, Banky Wellington, Sola Sobowale

title: King of Thieves
logline: A legendary bandit becomes a folk hero while evading both colonial authorities and rival gangs in 1950s Nigeria.
synopsis: Agesinkole, the most notorious thief in Yorubaland, robs from corrupt merchants and colonial officials. But as his legend grows, so does the price on his head. Based on Yoruba folklore, this epic tale explores heroism, justice, and survival.
cast: Femi Adebayo, Toyin Abraham, Odunlade Adekola

title: Afrobeats: The Documentary
logline: An inside look at how Afrobeats conquered the world music scene.
synopsis: From Lagos nightclubs to Madison Square Garden, this documentary traces Afrobeats' journey from underground movement to global phenomenon. Featuring exclusive interviews with Burna Boy, Wizkid, Davido, and the producers who created the sound.
cast: Documentary

title: Shanty Town
logline: A group of courtesans attempt to escape the criminal underworld controlling their lives.
synopsis: In a Lagos shanty town, a powerful gang lord controls everything. When a group of women working in his brothel decide to fight back, they set in motion a dangerous game of survival, betrayal, and redemption.
cast: Ini Edo, Nancy Isime, Shaffy Bello, Richard Mofe-Damijo

title: Demon Slayer Chronicles
logline: An African warrior must master ancient powers to protect humanity from supernatural threats.
synopsis: In a world where demons walk among humans, Koffi discovers he's the last descendant of an ancient order of demon slayers. With his mystical blade and growing powers, he must prevent an apocalypse while uncovering the truth about his family's massacre.
cast: Animated Series

title: Iyanu: Child of Wonder
logline: A young orphan discovers she has powerful magical abilities that could save her world from destruction.
synopsis: In the ancient kingdom of Yorubaland, a teenage girl named Iyanu awakens extraordinary powers. As dark forces threaten to destroy everything, she must embrace her destiny and master abilities she never knew she had.
cast: Animated Series
tags: anime, fantasy, coming of age, magic

title: Lagos Love Stories
logline: Interconnected tales of romance, heartbreak, and second chances in modern Lagos.
synopsis: From penthouse suites to market stalls, love blooms in unexpected places across Lagos. This anthology series explores how different couples navigate the complexities of modern Nigerian relationships.
cast: Ensemble Cast

title: Fela: The Musical Concert
logline: A live performance celebrating the life and music of Fela Kuti, the father of Afrobeat.
synopsis: Experience the revolutionary spirit of Fela Anikulapo Kuti in this electrifying concert film. Featuring live performances of his greatest hits, archival footage, and stories from those who knew him best.
cast: Made Kuti, Seun Kuti, Various Artists

title: Burna Boy: Live at Madison Square Garden
logline: African Giant takes over New York in this historic sold-out performance.
synopsis: Witness history as Burna Boy becomes one of the first African artists to sell out Madison Square Garden. This concert film captures the energy, passion, and global impact of Afrobeats music.
cast: Burna Boy

title: The Awakening
logline: A young priestess must prevent an ancient evil from consuming her village.
synopsis: When mysterious deaths plague her village, priestess Amara discovers an ancient deity has been awakened. With the help of her spiritual guides and a warrior she doesn't trust, she must perform a dangerous ritual to save her people.
cast: Beverly Naya, Wale Ojo, Deyemi Okanlawon

title: Chef's Table: West Africa
logline: Renowned chefs share their passion for West African cuisine and the stories behind their signature dishes.
synopsis: From traditional jollof rice to modern fusion cuisine, this series explores West African food culture through the eyes of innovative chefs who are bringing African flavors to the world stage.
cast: Documentary Series

title: Wizkid: Made in Lagos Live
logline: Star Boy delivers an unforgettable performance celebrating his groundbreaking album.
synopsis: Experience Wizkid's electrifying live performance of his critically acclaimed album 'Made in Lagos.' With special guests and stunning visuals, this concert film showcases why he's one of Africa's biggest musical exports.
cast: Wizkid, Various Guest Artists

title: Brotherhood
logline: Twin brothers on opposite sides of the law face off in a battle that will destroy their family.
synopsis: Taiwo is a police officer, Kehinde is a crime lord. When their paths collide during a major operation, the brothers must confront their shared past and choose between blood and duty.
cast: Tobi Bakre, Falz, Ronke Oshodi Oke

title: The Griot's Tale
logline: An animated anthology of West African folktales passed down through generations.
synopsis: Journey through time with a wise griot who shares tales of cunning Anansi, brave warriors, clever tricksters, and powerful spirits. Each episode brings to life a different story from Africa's rich oral tradition.
cast: Animated Series
